description: SIRI SX LITE et GTFS RT Service Alerts - informations en temps réel sur les trains is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données, en temps réel, vous permettra d'accéder, sous le format SIRI SX Lite et GTFS-RT SA, au flux des messages d'incidents affectés aux circulations TGV, Intercités et TER. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Systèmes d'information, Services voyageurs. Its keywords are Temps réel, information voyageurs, TGV, Intercités, Ouigo, TER. The portal shows 2026-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/cgu/A1#A1). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
